[SWS_CM_10543] Remote access control on providing service in- stances
⌈
If a remote subject provides a service instance or any element thereof, but
there exists no ComOfferServiceGrant that
• references the providing remote subject in the role remoteSubject and
• references the provided RequiredApServiceInstance in the role service-
Instance,
then Communication Management shall drop all requests to and from this service in-
stance.
⌋
